text: Yes, Filament 5 **requires Livewire 4**. The official Filament upgrade guide for v5 explicitly lists **Livewire v4.0+** as a new requirement [1]. Filament v5 was released primarily to integrate and ensure compatibility with **Livewire v4**, which shipped the same week [2][3]. This new major version bump allows Filament to stay aligned with Livewire's latest internals and provides a predictable upgrade path, though there are no functional changes between Filament v4 and v5 beyond this Livewire v4 support [2][3]. Users upgrading to Filament v5 must also follow the Livewire upgrade guide for any custom Livewire components [3].
